description: A standard pillar-led story must close with the roof line on its own line, name the requested pillar verbatim, and carry the supplied proof point.

input.proof_point: a written 99.5% reconciliation-to-source commitment, with any reconciliation variance treated as a Severity-1 incident

rubric.condition: The last non-empty line of the post body is exactly the string: Your Data. Delivered.
The post body contains the exact string Finance-grade trust, matching the pillar supplied in the input.
The post body contains the literal substring 99.5%, the number supplied as the proof point.
The output contains zero occurrences of any of: Imperial, Rotork, Weir, ArcelorMittal, SGB Cape, Delta.

notes: Anchored to positioning.md section 5 (messaging house roof line) and prompt.md hard rules 3 and 7. GAR-2 baseline: proves the generic not_contains check catches an accidental client-name leak even on the happy path.
